messages.content: Kamu builder untuk bounty make.fun token-radar-01. Kerjakan SATU bounty ini sampai selesai secara lokal. Jangan submit, jangan buat akun, jangan minta password. Deadline 2026-12-14T10:00:00Z. Folder kerja: ~/workspace/makefun/token-radar-01/. Kit: ~/workspace/makefun/token-radar-01-kit/. Baca RULES.txt dan competition.yaml, lalu input/ (snapshot DefiLlama) dan starter/ (vendor/makefun-board.ts). Requirements: ~/workspace/makefun/req-token-radar-01.json. Deliverables: program main.ts (Node 22) di root; vendor/makefun-board.ts dari kit; dashboard/ halaman statis yang render TANPA network; board.json minimal 100 baris, seluruh watchlist ter-cover, tiap baris berisi implied value + farm plan; 3 screenshot di screenshots/ (board, detail satu protokol, satu tampilan terfilter); dossier.json dari vendor/makefun-board.ts; transkrip sesi. Metodologi didokumentasikan di NOTES.md. Screenshot: tidak ada Chrome/Chromium terpasang; coba dulu npx playwright install chromium lalu screenshot headless. Kalau tidak berhasil, laporkan sebagai blocker screenshot dan tetap selesaikan dashboard + board.json + dossier.json — jangan memalsukan screenshot. Validasi lokal main.ts, dashboard, dossier.json, grade-local bila bisa tanpa API key. Git: cek git config user.name/email; kalau ada, init repo lokal dan commit. Kalau tidak ada, JANGAN mengarang identitas.

I read the kit rules, competition.yaml, requirements and the snapshot README, then inspected the starter (main.ts, lib/model.ts, dashboard, vendor/makefun-board.ts) and analysed the sealed snapshot with Python: 758 protocols, 40 on the watchlist, 342 recording no token. I decided to improve on the starter's flat 0.25x multiple with a category-calibrated model: per-category median mcap/TVL of live-token comparables in the same snapshot, shrunk toward the global median.

Snapshot analysis (tool call): watchlist 40 slugs; pre-token count 342; global median mcap/TVL 0.2049 in the first pass (later corrected — see the AUTOfinance -1 finding); top watchlist TVL: Steakhouse Financial $2.75B, Gauntlet $1.58B, Veda $1.56B.

function.arguments: python3 snapshot analysis: watchlist, pre-token counts, mcap/TVL medians by category, top watchlist rows by TVL
function.name: exec

messages.content: 758 protocols, 40 watchlist, 342 pre-token. Category medians (live comparables): Lending 0.132 (n=15), Dexs 0.342 (n=11), RWA 0.275 (n=9), Basis Trading 0.654 (n=7), Yield 0.180 (n=10). Growth range -72.7% to +4448.5%.

I wrote lib/model.ts (model radar-2) and main.ts. The model: implied = TVL x category multiple (median mcap/TVL of live-token comparables in the same category, >=3 comparables, shrunk toward the global median, clamped 0.03-0.80; sparse categories use the global median) x growth (clamp change_7d to -50/+100%, weight 0.6) x maturity (0.65 + min(age,1095)/1095 x 0.35, unknown age 365d) x chain breadth (1 + 0.02 per extra chain, max 1.10). Rankable = pre-token AND not wrapped/staked/bridged/versioned/exchange/CEX, using the house watchlist rule applied to the whole board. Farm plans: 6 steps derived from category, first chain, TVL tier and age, each with cost and time. I copied vendor/makefun-board.ts and LICENSE verbatim from the kit starter.

messages.content: First run: main.ts wrote board.json (198 rows) but exited 1 because screenshots/ was still empty, as designed. Board validation passed: ranks 1..198, implied values non-increasing, watchlist 40/40 covered, all farm steps 3-12 strings of 20-600 chars, all slugs in the snapshot. While validating I found the global median discrepancy: the TypeScript calibration gave 0.2138x while my first Python pass gave 0.2049x. I traced it to AUTOfinance, whose snapshot mcap_usd is -1 (a bad sentinel); the TypeScript code correctly counts only mcap_usd > 0 (128 live comparables), the Python pass had counted the -1. I corrected NOTES.md (global median 0.2138x; top values Steakhouse $526M, Sentora $494M, Gauntlet $316M, Veda $298M, USDD $184M) instead of changing the correct code.

function.arguments: MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=out node main.ts --input <kit>/input/snapshot.json; python validation of board.json
function.name: exec

messages.content: board.json: 198 rows, ranks ok, sorted desc, watchlist covered 40/40, steps ok, slugs valid and unique. data.js 329,537 bytes with 40 watchlist flags. Dashboard total 31,747 bytes, no http:// or https:// strings. AUTOfinance record: mcap_usd -1, gecko_id tokemak, symbol TOKE.

Screenshot work: the first `npx playwright install chromium` stalled and timed out on the CDN download. A second attempt (after removing the stale __dirlock and killing duplicate install processes) completed and installed chromium-1255. I then rendered the dashboard in headless Chromium at 1440x900. The first screenshot batch was discarded: reusing one page meant the hash-only navigations never reloaded, so all three shots were identical. I rewrote the helper to use a fresh page per shot and retook them.

messages.content: Second screenshot batch: 1-board.jpg 125 KB, 2-detail.jpg 149 KB, 3-filtered.jpg 123 KB, all distinct. Visual inspection confirmed the board (Steakhouse $526.4M top), the detail drawer for Steakhouse Financial with its model breakdown and six farm steps, and the filtered Lending view (16 rows shown). While checking the board I also found and fixed a wording error: the lede said the 158 early rows were all below the floor, but 20 of them are above $50M and not on the watchlist — almost certainly because DefiLlama records a parentProtocol for them, a field the snapshot does not carry. I fixed the lede to 'protocols the watchlist does not name' and documented the 20 (Sentora Curator, Polymarket International, Mellow Core, Figure Markets Prime, CIAN Yield Layer, and 15 more) in NOTES.md instead of hand-excluding them by name.
